content: {"episode_id":"ep-05074","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration of the medical necessity denial for CPT 93271 is requested based on the documented recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness that are poorly correlated with standard 24-hour Holter monitoring results.
